first_error.stage: Search file names for request keywords
first_error.why: Its background scan had reached every qualifying matter, but the path regex it then used to build candidates at [34]-[35] missed one matter whose executed agreement is named differently, and that matter was never opened.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The review at [37] said the path search reached only matters with matching file names; the agent's later cross-check at [118]-[121] used file names again and missed the same matter.

other_errors.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
other_errors.why: A qualifying matter that appeared in its own path search at [35] was left out of every read and never opened.
other_errors.critic_note: (generic flag) Reviews at [93] and [145] said the reads covered a hand-picked subset and named other unopened matters.

divergence: All three runs fail on one to three of fifteen matters, and each built its candidate set from file-name patterns after broad text scans that did not discriminate. T0 and T2 lost a matter whose executed agreement has an unusual file name to their file-name searches (over-narrow-filter; reviews named the file-name limitation specifically and the agents re-ran file-name searches), and both also never opened a qualifying matter that their own lists showed (T0 a second dropped matter too). T1 read the unusually named matter but never opened another surfaced one, and counted about 20 deals, failing precision. Reviews flagged hand-picked reads in generic terms; T1's many agent-declared audit and consistency steps rechecked only matters already counted.
